boundary: This deterministic join classifies exact source-surface crossing pairs by declared source-family overlap, pinned BodyParts3D ontology relationships, and the existing coarse ontology priority classes. These relationships do not determine whether a crossing is an intentional nested representation, a duplicate, a segmentation seam, or an anatomical placement error. Intersection-segment length is not penetration depth, overlap volume, contact force, or clinical severity. No geometry or ownership was changed by this audit.
